event.description:
Venue: The Card Shop PLT
Fees: RM 45
Max Participants: 32

1st Prize: 1 AMB Pack, 4 black pack, Blazing Throw SEA National Qualified Card, 1 Materialize Polearm Store Championship playmat
2nd Prize: 3 AMB Pack and 4 black pack
3rd & 4th Prize: 3 AMB pack and 4 black pack each
5th to 8th Prize: 2 AMB pack and 3 black pack each
9th to 16th Prize: 1 Black Pack

Partipation Reward is 2 AMB pack and 1 Event Pack and Heighten SpellCraft Promo

Lucky Draw: Idle Thoughts Promo and more tba on that day

Kindly request to join Omnidex AND submit deck list prior to the event. Operational hours on that day will be extended and the shop will be opened to plays from 9.30am onwards to allow for players to come in and make payment before hand. First come first serve so, please avoid coming in late.

Booking of a slot will only be confirmed once payment has been made and verified by the organizers. Once the bookings have reached more than 32 players, those who have yet to paid for their bookings will be removed from the list one by one.
